# uncovered_functions_allowlist.txt -- shrink-only ledger of live non-test
# functions with 0% package test coverage on v1.3/comms (2026-10-14).
#
# One row per function: `<file> <func>`, where `<func>` is `FuncName` for a
# package-level function and `Recv.Method` for a method.
#
# This list only shrinks:
#   - Adding a row not present at the change's base is refused.
#   - A row whose file or function no longer exists is stale and is refused.
#   - In any package changed by a PR, an unlisted function at 0% coverage is
#     refused, a listed function modified by the PR and still at 0% coverage is
#     refused, and a listed function that is now covered by tests is refused
#     until its row is removed.
